record_scope_reconstruction: Two DRC customs-service locations, Karombo and Goli/Anzida in Mahagi territory. Separate internal RN27 blockade near Mahagi is not a third border post. Goli can be located approximately from the published crossing marker; Karombo remains unlocated in this reconstruction.

source_checks.finding: Full May 14 report explicitly names closed DGDA/OCC offices at Karombo and Goli/Anzida; wider no-entry/no-exit is attributed to a local advocate. RN27 road interruption about 10 km from Mahagi is distinct.

AU-PIDA original Appendix A row E41 independently inspected: Mahagi–Goli latitude 2.37673 longitude 31.02969. Approximate paired crossing reference; no exact DGDA or OCC office footprint. Cached PDF binary is truncated, so no full PDF visual verification claimed.
Primary WHO indexed account independently names Padea/Karombo border checkpoint in Zombo district, corroborating paired identity but supplying no exact Karombo customs-office coordinates.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Modal scope: multiple_named_sites. May 14, 2020 DGDA/OCC service closure observation. Partial named-site set: approximate Goli/Anzida crossing only; no claim of universal passenger ban or a continuous 2020–2021 stoppage.
